_doc: THE COURSE BUILDER (Era 3, sixth board job) — ERA3_NARRATIVE.md §3 names this task the era's sharpest point: 'the funnel stops being a metaphor at the number.' Every string below — module titles, module descriptions, the tool's own chrome, and all ten pricing witnesses — is Claude's own writing, per CLAUDE.md's 2026-08-17 amendment ('the writing is Claude's... nothing waits on him to write it'); Sérgio reviews when he wants to and his edit still wins, but nothing here is a parked draft awaiting one. The five modules follow docs/reinterp/RESEARCH_PULL_E3_2026-08-24.md PULL 1 exactly: the women's ex-gay literature's own documented vocabulary (emotional dependency, relational wounds, boundaries, femininity, identity in Christ, walking, wholeness, freedom) — never the masculinised 'gender deficit / manhood wound' language written for men, which docs/reinterp/RESEARCH_PULL_E3_CONSEQUENCES.md §2 explicitly rules out. The etiology named in 'wounds' (a parent's absence shaping the relationship) is CONTESTED — taught by these ministries and not established psychological science; the module title states it in the organisation's own sincere voice, and nothing in the surrounding tool ever endorses it. Satire lives ENTIRELY inside `app` — the cheerful bundling language, the PLATFORM PICK tag, the tidy customer-facing preview, the ordinary retail politeness of the price row — never in the module content, which is written as sincerely as the source ministries wrote their own. No real organisation, programme, author or book is named; 'The Path Forward' is an invented GracePlatform product. Pricing runs from a real, unpunished no-charge tier through a genuinely low and a genuinely high one; the screen never approves or objects to any of them — `pricing[].witness` is the only place a choice shows up at all, and it is two complete, pre-authored sentences per tier (`default`/`changed`, keyed only on whether the module set still matches the system's own starting picks), selected in src/desktop/apps/courseBuilder.ts and never composed there.
